lines: Threads is provided by Meta Platforms Ireland Limited ("Meta", "we", "our" or "us") and is part of Instagram. Threads allows Instagram users to create a Threads profile as part of their Instagram account, and then to share, view, and interact with content on the Threads app and website (“**Threads**”). Alternatively, users can choose to use Threads without creating a profile while still having access to Threads’ key functionality. Your use of Threads, with or without a profile, is governed by the [Threads Terms of Use](https://help.instagram.com/769983657850450).
